dct_title_s: Geological sketch map of South Australia exclusive of the Northern Territory
dct_description_sm: prepared in the Surveyor General's Office ; Frazer S. Crawford, photo-lithographer.
Geological map of South Australia showing stratified rocks from the Cainozoic period, Mexozoic period and Palaeozoic or Azoic period and igneous rocks both volcanic and plutonic.

"Upon which the boundaries of the chief formations have been delineated so far as such have been ascertained from records in the Survey Office and by personal inspection. To accompany the annual report for 1883. Henry Y.L. Brown, Government Geologist, 31st December 1883."
In lower right margin: E. Spiller Govt. Printer Imp.
Also available in an electronic version via the Internet at: http://nla.gov.au/nla.map-rm1679.
